name: RSS Reader
description: Beautiful three-pane RSS reader. Consumes the rss-registry catalog, tracks read/starred state per item.
long_description: A modern, dynamic RSS reader UI: categories sidebar, item inbox with live preview, full reader pane with formatted article view. Supports unread tracking, starring, search, filters by feed/category/language, manual + automatic refresh, and live updates when the registry pushes new items.
author: Kernl
